snippets.BOOKWORM_PETS_01: Good day, little Panda! What brings you here? I'm very busy, you know.
snippets.BOOKWORM_PETS_03: So, you're saying you want me to speed up the aging process of the chili plant? My time machine can be a bit finicky, as you know. I can't promise you anything!
snippets.BOOKWORM_PETS_04: But I will try. Come back tomorrow, my little friend. Then we can take a look together to see if the chili plant has grown.
snippets.BOOKWORM_PETS_05: Come back tomorrow. Then we will look together and see if the chili plant has grown.
snippets.BOOKWORM_PETS_06: I couldn't wait! I already looked and I have good news: the plant aging process was successful and there are chilies ready to be picked!
snippets.BOOKWORM_PETS_07: I don't know what you want with the plant, but I give you this warning: under no circumstance should you try the chilies. Your Panda palate is much too sensitive!
snippets.BOOKWORM_PETS_08: Bring the plant straight to Bruno. He'll know what to do. But hurry! They go bad quickly! Good luck!
snippets.BRUNO_PETS_01: Hello, $$name$$. Come for a serving a fat-free French fries with home made ketchup? No? What then?
snippets.BRUNO_PETS_02: What? Chili chips? You must like it really hot!
snippets.BRUNO_PETS_03: Oh, they're not for you. Yes, I can make some, but I will need super spicy chilies from a chili plant. The chili plant grows only near volcanoes, where it's hot enough for them to grow.
snippets.BRUNO_PETS_04: Bring me a couple of super spicy chilies from the chili plant.
snippets.BRUNO_PETS_05: Oh no! I thought this might happen! The chili plant is far too young and has not yet bared fruit. No chilies, no chili chips. But...maybe this could work...
snippets.BRUNO_PETS_06: Professor Bookworm's time machine! We could put the plant in and age it until it's old enough to bloom. I'm so clever!
snippets.BRUNO_PETS_07: Take the plant to the professor and ask him if you can stick it in his time machine. Let's cross our fingers that it works!
snippets.BRUNO_PETS_08: Wow! I guess it worked! I'll start preparing. I'll need to leave the chips in the oven overnight so that they get good and crunchy.
snippets.BRUNO_PETS_09: You'll have to be patient. Come back tomorrow, okay?
snippets.BRUNO_PETS_10: I've been waiting for you! I didn't get any sleep the whole night. Wanna know why?
snippets.BRUNO_PETS_11: Yesterday, as I was putting the chips in the oven I heard a terrible sound. It sounded like it was coming from the dining area, but the restaurant was already closed.
snippets.BRUNO_PETS_12: All the guests had been gone for hours! I grabbed a dough roller and tip-toed out of the kitchen to catch the burglar...
snippets.BRUNO_PETS_13: ...but no one was there! Not a soul around. Whoever it was must have snuck right back out when he heard me coming. He left behind something strange: a riddle!
snippets.BRUNO_PETS_14: I tried to solve that riddle all night, but just couldn't! What could the answer be?!
snippets.BRUNO_PETS_15: The riddle is sitting over there under the cheese cover. Can you help me? I need to sleep again! Then I'll give you your chili chips! I promise!
snippets.BRUNO_PETS_16: Finally! Thank you! I should have thought of that. I can now sleep once again in peace.
snippets.BRUNO_PETS_17: Here are your freshly-baked chili chips. I'm sure those Pokopets would follow you to the ends of the world with these chips. I would try a couple myself if they weren't so spicy. See you around, clever Panda!
snippets.BRUNO_PETS_GO_DEFAULT: I hope I was able to help out.
snippets.BRUNO_PETS_GO_FEED: Go back to the plane and feed the hungry Pokopets.
snippets.ELOISE_PETS_01: Gross! What kind of mixture was that?
snippets.ELOISE_PETS_02: I can speak again! Yeah! Thanks! But I still can't move. Go look for scissors so you can cut through these ropes. Perhaps there is a clothes maker on Panfu? They always have scissors!
snippets.ELOISE_PETS_03: I still can't move. Go look for scissors to cut these ropes. I'm sure there's a clothing maker at Panfu. They always have scissors.
snippets.ELOISE_PETS_04: Yes! Finally, I'm free! Thank you, dear Panda. Oh, you have to take the scissors back? Do it quickly and then come straight back!
snippets.ELOISE_PETS_04A: You have to bring the scissors back? Do it quickly and then come right back!
snippets.ELOISE_PETS_05: I never introduced myself! I'm Eloise, an old friend of Kamaria. I'm into the field of animal conservation and would do anything to protect them from someone so evil as Bonez!
snippets.ELOISE_PETS_06: Bonez has traveled the world to collect these rare Pokopets to sell to a toy factory. They would be killed and stuffed into toys. We have to stop him!
snippets.ELOISE_PETS_07: I snuck into Bonez's plane and unscrewed an important screw in the engine while he was flying over Panfu. The engine stopped and he had no other choice but to land on Panfu.
snippets.ELOISE_PETS_08: He was super-angry when he discovered me on his plane! He gave me a chewing-gum drink and tied me up so that I wouldn't get in his way again. Then he left to go look for another screw.
snippets.ELOISE_PETS_09: Time is precious! Please open the two cages and free the Pokopets. But heed my warning: Bonez has secured the cages very well.
snippets.ELOISE_PETS_10: Hurry! He could be back any minute!
snippets.ELOISE_PETS_11: Good job! But why aren't the Pokopets hopping out of the cages? They seem to be in shock. You'll have to win their trust with chili chips!
snippets.ELOISE_PETS_12: Pokopets love nothing more than extra-spicy chili chips. Is there a chef at Panfu? Perhaps he can make some.
snippets.ELOISE_PETS_13: The Pokopets are in a state of shock and won't hop out of their cages. You'll have to lure them with chili chips. Look for a chef who could make you some and the come back.
snippets.ELOISE_PETS_14: Great, you have the Chili Crossies! Feed them to the Pokopets and go to the Pokopet Barn. You'll see how fast they'll follow you then! I'm right behind you! Let's go!
snippets.ELOISE_PETS_14A: Phew, that was a close one! What a relief that the Pokopets finally have a new home. Thank you so much for your help. I can tell that you're an animal lover! I would even trust you with one to take care of! I'm sure you'd do a great job.
snippets.ELOISE_PETS_15: The Pokopets have to get used to Panfu first. Once they have re-adjusted, you'll get your own Pokopet to take care of! I give my word!
snippets.ELOISE_PETS_16: Here's a Pokopet voucher. You'll be able to trade it later for a Pokopet. You'll have a great new friend very soon.
snippets.ELOISE_PETS_17: We still have to chase the evil Bonez from Panfu! As long as he's here, the Pokopets are still in danger!
snippets.ELOISE_PETS_18: I have a plan. Let's go back to the airplane. I'll explain more there.
snippets.ELOISE_PETS_19: You see the broken engine? Well, it's not really broken. I just took a screw out to force Bonez to land on Panfu soil. I still have the screw in my pocket!
snippets.ELOISE_PETS_20: Here's the plan: you put the screw back into the engine. The engine is really loud, so Bonez is sure to hear it.
snippets.ELOISE_PETS_21: Here's the screw. Once the engine is running, I'll tell you what to do next.
snippets.ELOISE_PETS_22: Get the engine running again. You already have the screw. I'll tell you afterwards what we'll do next.
snippets.ELOISE_PETS_23: When Bonez hears the airplane's engine, he's sure to come back and see what's happening. As soon as he gets in the plane, press the red button to trap Bonez inside the plane.
snippets.ELOISE_PETS_24: I've locked it on auto pilot on a direct course to the Himalayas. Great plan, don't you think?
snippets.ELOISE_PETS_25: We'll have to hide so that Bonez doesn't get suspicious. Let's get out of here and come back a little later.
snippets.ELOISE_PETS_26: There! Bonez is inside! Press the red button and blast him off to the Himalayas! Woo hoo! Thanks, Panda! You have proven your courage and saved the Pokopets! Press that button now!
snippets.KAMARIA_PETS_01: An unknown lady-Panda? In a plane? Tied up?! I'll come with you! Let's go!
snippets.KAMARIA_PETS_02: Oh my! Eloise! That's Eloise, my buddy from Africa! Who did this?!
snippets.KAMARIA_PETS_03: It seems as though someone gave her a chewing gum drink so that she wouldn't speak. But they didn't know that they'd have to deal with me! Of course I know of a potion to break this spell.
snippets.KAMARIA_PETS_04: But first I'll need a few rare ingredients: one blossom from the rainbow plant, a handfull of star herbs and a glass full of toad slime. Here's an empty glass. Please fill it with the toad slime.
snippets.KAMARIA_PETS_05: Toads like to hide in creepy, dark places. Think of a place like this on Panfu and look there. It takes a lot of patience to collect toad slime. But you can do it!
snippets.KAMARIA_PETS_06: For the potion I will need a lot of toad slime. Via the Telescope at the Volcano you'll reach a place where toads feel right at home. Come back when you have collected enough slime.
snippets.KAMARIA_PETS_07: Super! The toad slime is the main component of my potion. Now I'll need star herbs. The tend to grow in sandy soils. Go pick a handfull and bring it to me.
snippets.KAMARIA_PETS_08: Please bring me a handfull of star herbs. They grow best in sandy soil.
snippets.KAMARIA_PETS_09: Thank you! Star herbs are the only thing that can cover the disgusting toad smell of the potion. The last ingredient I'll need is a blossom from the rainbow plant. It was imported to Panfu all the way from the Caribbean.
snippets.KAMARIA_PETS_10: I still need a blossom from the rainbow plant, which was imported to Panfu from the Caribbean.
snippets.KAMARIA_PETS_11: Excellent! Now I have all I need. The potion will have to cook a long time before it develops its magical properties. Come back tomorrow to the castle tower. I'll see you then.
snippets.KAMARIA_PETS_12: The potion must cook for a long time to develop its magical properties. Come tomorrow to the castle tower. I'll see you then!
snippets.KAMARIA_PETS_12_IN_TOWER: The potion has to simmer for quite a while. Please come back here tomorrow, then we will see what's next.
snippets.KAMARIA_PETS_13: The potion is done! Give it to Eloise. It will unstick that sticky gum!
snippets.LILI_PETS_02: What? A bound lady-Panda? Really? Sure, I'll give you my scissors, but please bring them back. I won't be able to make new clothes without them.
snippets.LILI_PETS_03: Thanks, I'm glad I could help. Good luck!
snippets.PETS_FIRST_FINISH_OTHER: Hey there! You have to finish playing your current quest before you can start this one. Come back when you're done with the other.
snippets.POPUP_BARNHINT_01: You're currently playing the 'Save the Pokopets' quest and cannot begin Eloise's assignment until you are done. You can also choose to stop playing the quest by cancelling it and then logging in again.
snippets.POPUP_PETS_01: Most animals are closely-knit packs. But there are exceptions. The following pop-up displays animals that lead to other animals. There is one path, however, that connects to no other animal. Which one is it?
snippets.POPUP_PETS_02: How did the Pokopets get to Panfu? You'll be able to uncover it all on this quest!
snippets.POPUP_PETS_03: Sorry, that wasn't correct. Come back tomorrow and try again.
snippets.POPUP_PETS_04: What a clever Panda! You've solved the puzzle!
snippets.POPUP_PETS_05: Bonez lights eight candles in his bathroom. Yes, it's that smelly! Suddenly, a bat flies through the window and extinguishes four candles with the wind from its wings. The bat realizes the bathroom smells and flies back out the window. A bit later, Bonez comes back and notices that one more candle has been blown out by the wind. He closes the window and goes to bed. How man candles are left when he wakes up? Click on the arrow and type in your answer.
snippets.POPUP_PETS_07: Wow, you solved the puzzle! Here's how it goes: four candles were blown out by the bat and one from the wind. Because these candles aren't lit, they can't burn down. The three that are left burn until they are gone since they weren't blown out. The correct answer is five!
snippets.POPUP_PETS_08: A turtle is on the run from Bonez. When the turtle was a baby, her mother told her how to best get rid of someone following her: she's never allowed to turn around or go backwards and whenever she comes to an intersection, she has to go right or left - never straight ahead. The turtle plans to go to the beach where she can escape in the water. If she follows her mother's advice, which beach will she never be able to reach?
snippets.POPUP_PETS_11: Congratulations! You've chased away the evil Bonez and have saved the Pokopets! Great job completing this quest!
snippets.POPUP_PETS_12: Now go to the Pokopet Barn - we'll follow you!
snippets.POPUP_PETS_13: You already have a Pokopet voucher in your inventory. You can't receive this rare item twice.
snippets.POPUP_PETS_14: Eloise is waiting for you in the barn with an important assignment. If you start this quest, you won't be able to help her. Do you really want to begin this quest?
